summary.en: The Electrical and Mechanical Services Department has removed an induction cooker model from the record of listed models under the Energy Efficiency (Labelling of Products) Ordinance, meaning it may no longer be supplied in Hong Kong from today. The model is ecHome IDCS2100BK; sample compliance monitoring tests showed it failed to meet the relevant energy-efficiency and performance characteristics. Importer E.P.S.A. Corporation Limited has been notified and will publish a newspaper announcement that supply has been discontinued.

summary.en: The Ministry of Finance issued US$2 billion of sovereign bonds in Hong Kong yesterday, with a three-year tenor and a coupon of 4.821%, all listed on the Hong Kong Stock Exchange. The issue drew enthusiastic demand from international investors, with total orders of US$72.3 billion, more than 36 times the issue size. Asian investors accounted for 52%, Europe and the Middle East 34%, and the Americas 14%. The ministry has issued US dollar sovereign bonds in Hong Kong several times since 2017, including a record US$6 billion in 2020 and US$4 billion last November.

summary.en: Hong Kong's two power companies will announce next year's tariff adjustment plans on Tuesday, with the Legislative Council's Panel on Environmental Affairs to first discuss the outcome of the annual tariff review. In November, CLP's average net tariff was 148.6 cents per unit, up about 5.7% from January, while HK Electric's net tariff was 183 cents per unit, up about 12% from January. Both companies said international energy prices remain volatile and they will use prudent procurement and diversified fuel strategies to limit the impact of fuel price swings on customers.

summary.zh_hant: 兩間電力公司將於下星期二公布明年電費調整方案，立法會環境事務委員會將先討論周年電費檢討結果。今年11月，中電平均淨電價為每度電148.6仙，較今年1月上調約5.7%；港燈11月淨電價為每度電183仙，較1月上升約12%。兩電都表示國際能源價格持續波動，會透過審慎採購及多元化燃料策略，盡量減低燃料價格波動對用戶的影響。

summary.en: The leaders of China, Russia and the United States held a historic meeting yesterday and issued a Peace Declaration, saying the three countries, as permanent members of the UN Security Council, are committed to advancing UN reform. The three countries plan to increase production and supply of refined petroleum products and will hold dialogue on reducing nuclear risks and preventing nuclear proliferation. Scholars said the declaration points the way for UN reform, noting China has long insisted on reform and that, as the influence of different countries has changed greatly since the UN was founded, improving representation will be a key focus. Increasing refined oil supply could bring geopolitical stability and confidence to markets.
summary.zh_hans: 中俄美三国元首昨日举行历史性会晤后发表《和平宣言》，提到三国作为联合国安理会常任理事国，致力推动联合国改革；三国计划增加精炼石油产品的生产和供应，并将就减少核风险、防止核扩散举行对话。有学者认为，宣言为联合国改革提供方向，过去中国一直坚持改革，现时不同国家的影响力已大为变化，如何提升各国代表性将是改革重点；增加精炼石油产品供应可为地缘政治带来稳定性、为市场带来信心。
summary.zh_hant: 中俄美三國元首昨日舉行歷史性會晤後發表《和平宣言》，提到三國作為聯合國安理會常任理事國，致力推動聯合國改革；三國計劃增加精煉石油產品的生產和供應，並將就減少核風險、防止核擴散舉行對話。有學者認為，宣言為聯合國改革提供方向，過去中國一直堅持改革，現時不同國家的影響力已大為變化，如何提升各國代表性將是改革重點；增加精煉石油產品供應可為地緣政治帶來穩定性、為市場帶來信心。

summary.en: Chief Executive John Lee addressed the fourth APEC Next-Gen Young Entrepreneurs Summit by video, under the theme "From Ideas to Impact: Young Entrepreneurs Driving Asia-Pacific Growth". He said artificial intelligence is reshaping the economy and that the creativity and collaborative spirit of young entrepreneurs matter, encouraging young people to seize opportunities in the Greater Bay Area. Lee added that Hong Kong's first Youth Development Blueprint has rolled out more than 340 measures in four years, and the First Five-Year Plan will further expand opportunities for youth, with Hong Kong serving as the Greater Bay Area's core international hub connecting the mainland with the world.

summary.en: Chief Executive John Lee officiated at the grand opening of the inaugural InfraEX Week 2026, attended by about 800 infrastructure leaders, officials and professionals from more than 30 countries and economies, with about 1,000 more joining online. Lee said Hong Kong's First Five-Year Plan, closely aligned with the National 15th Five-Year Plan, provides a strategic roadmap for the city's future. The Northern Metropolis covers one-third of Hong Kong's area and will house about 2.5 million people, create 500,000 jobs and account for about 13% of GDP. The week brings together three concurrent events under the theme "Envisioning a Sustainable Future: From Insights to Impacts".
summary.zh_hans: 行政长官李家超今日主持首届InfraEX Week 2026开幕礼，约800名来自30多个国家及经济体的基建领袖、官员及专业人士出席，另约1,000人网上参与。李家超表示，香港首个五年计划与国家「十五五」规划衔接，为香港未来提供策略蓝图；北部都会区占全港三分之一面积，将容纳约250万人、创造50万个职位，占本地生产总值约13%。活动涵盖三项同期活动，主题为「展望可持续未来：从洞见到影响」。
summary.zh_hant: 行政長官李家超今日主持首屆InfraEX Week 2026開幕禮，約800名來自30多個國家及經濟體的基建領袖、官員及專業人士出席，另約1,000人網上參與。李家超表示，香港首個五年計劃與國家「十五五」規劃銜接，為香港未來提供策略藍圖；北部都會區佔全港三分之一面積，將容納約250萬人、創造50萬個職位，佔本地生產總值約13%。活動涵蓋三項同期活動，主題為「展望可持續未來：從洞見到影響」。

summary.en: Hong Kong stocks opened below this year's low, with the Hang Seng Index at 22,482 in the pre-opening auction, down 359 points or about 1.6%, a new low for the year. Alibaba steadied after 10 straight days of losses, opening about 1% higher, after adjusted profit rose 92% year on year but still missed expectations. NetEase and Kuaishou fell more than 13% and 8% respectively after their results.

summary.en: The US dollar index kept pushing toward the 104 level, touching 103.97, up more than 0.1%, a fresh high in more than a year and a half and its eighth straight daily gain. US Treasury yields moved lower, with the 10-year yield testing the 5% level, touching a low of 5.04%, down about 3 basis points; the 30-year yield briefly fell below 5.4%, while the 2-year yield slipped to a low of 4.755%. summary.en: Hong Kong turned markedly colder this morning, with the Observatory recording a minimum temperature of 15.3°C as of 5:30am, the lowest since autumn began. The Observatory issued the Strong Monsoon Signal at 4:45am, with northerly strong winds expected across the territory, averaging more than 40 kilometres per hour and occasionally reaching gale force in gusts. The Observatory said a strong northeast monsoon and a band of cloud and rain are affecting the Guangdong coast, with cloudy skies and a few showers expected today; daytime temperatures in the urban areas will range from 14 to 16 degrees, one or two degrees lower in the New Territories, where some areas and high ground will feel cold. The public is advised to keep warm.

title.en: Mongolian Parliament Approves President Khurelsukh's Resignation With 96 Votes in Favour, a First for a Sitting President

title.zh_hant: 蒙古總統閃辭獲國會通過 96票贊成 創史上首位在任總統提前下台

summary.en: Mongolia's parliament has voted to approve President Ukhnaagiin Khurelsukh's resignation, with 96 of the 104 voting members backing the motion. It is the first time in Mongolia's history that a sitting president has voluntarily stepped down early. Under the constitution, the parliament speaker will act as president until a new president is sworn in, and parliament must call a presidential election within four months. Khurelsukh, elected in 2021, announced his resignation on November 17. He has denied allegations of abuse of power and corruption, saying he made no policy mistakes and never took state or public property.

summary.en: Denmark's parliament has passed a security and defence agreement covering Greenland, its autonomous territory. Signed in September this year by Denmark, Greenland and the United States at the United Nations headquarters in New York, the deal revises the 1951 US-Denmark defence agreement, allowing the US to set up new defence areas in Greenland, upgrade facilities and expand military operations. It will take effect once Denmark and Greenland complete their parliamentary approval procedures and the US receives the relevant diplomatic note; Greenland's parliament already passed the agreement on November 3.

summary.zh_hant: 丹麥議會表決通過一項涉及丹麥自治領地格陵蘭島的安全與防衛協議。相關協議今年9月由丹麥、格陵蘭島與美國在紐約聯合國總部簽署，修訂美國與丹麥1951年簽署的防務協定，允許美國在格陵蘭島設立新的防務區域，以及升級相關設施和擴大軍事行動。根據協議，丹麥和格陵蘭島完成議會審批程序後，協議將在美方收到相關外交照會後生效。格陵蘭自治議會已經在本月3日通過協議。

summary.en: Vitasoy International's interim profit for the six months to the end of September rose nearly 8% year on year to HK$185 million, up about 3% excluding currency effects, with an interim dividend of 4 cents per share maintained. Revenue for the half year was HK$3.337 billion, up 3% year on year and down 1% excluding currency effects; gross margin widened 0.8 percentage points to 51.9%, helped by currency movements, lower raw-material costs and improved production efficiency, partly offset by higher trade promotion spending. Mainland revenue rose 5.4% to HK$1.874 billion, with operating profit up 25% to about HK$240 million; Hong Kong revenue was about HK$1.112 billion, broadly flat, with operating profit up 0.7% to nearly HK$140 million. The group expects intensifying price competition, high oil prices and the restructuring of its Australian business to weigh significantly on profitability in the second half.

summary.en: The Health Bureau has announced that Hong Kong, China has formally joined the International Council for Harmonisation of Technical Requirements for Pharmaceuticals for Human Use (ICH) as a regulatory member, represented by the Hong Kong Pharmacy and Poisons Board. The ICH approved the decision at its assembly in Czechia on November 17, making Hong Kong, China its 20th regulatory member. Hong Kong became an ICH observer on October 31, 2023 and reached full membership in just three years, far faster than the government's earlier estimate of eight to ten years. Secretary for Health Professor Lo Chung-mau said membership will help develop Hong Kong's capacity and mechanisms for "first-tier approval" of innovative drugs and deepen participation in setting international rules for drug research and registration. The government will set up a Centre for Medical Products Regulation next month to build independent drug evaluation and approval capability.

summary.en: The volume of retired electric-vehicle batteries is expected to rise from about 1,300 tonnes this year to about 6,700 tonnes in 2030. The Environment and Ecology Bureau has submitted a paper to the Legislative Council proposing a producer responsibility scheme for EV batteries, charging EV suppliers a recycling levy based on battery weight, starting at HK$6 per kilogram and rising steadily each year. For a typical private car with a 500-kilogram battery, the starting charge would be about HK$3,000, rising by HK$800 a year to HK$15,000 by 2043. The scheme covers power batteries of battery-electric and plug-in hybrid vehicles, including private cars, taxis, motorcycles and electric commercial vehicles other than franchised buses. The government aims to submit an amendment bill to the Legislative Council next year, enter a preparatory phase in 2028 and roll the scheme out fully in 2029. More than 180,000 EVs already distributed before the scheme starts will be exempt, and owners who replace a battery or scrap a vehicle can enjoy one free recycling and vehicle deregistration.

summary.en: Jared Kushner, son-in-law of US President Donald Trump and his special envoy, said Russia has agreed to European participation in a multilateral negotiating mechanism, adding that restarting direct dialogue between Europe and Russia is especially important. A summit of the UK- and France-led "Coalition of the Willing" supporting Ukraine was held in Berlin, where Kushner told a press conference afterwards that Russia could accept Ukraine receiving security guarantees similar to NATO's Article 5 collective defence clause, while also expressing a desire for no new conflict to break out. Kushner stressed that such guarantees would need a mechanism covering monitoring and verification, deterrence and other measures, and that Trump is open to this provided it serves US interests. Neither the United States nor the European Union is a member of the coalition, but special envoy Steve Witkoff, European Council President Antonio Costa, European Commission President Ursula von der Leyen and NATO Secretary-General Mark Rutte also attended. Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky said Europe must be included in the peace talks, and it is not yet clear how NATO Article 5-style security guarantees would work.

summary.en: The government plans to set up a Building Maintenance Support and Services Bureau, with the Development Bureau submitting a funding paper to the Legislative Council. The bureau follows the government's announcement after the Wang Fuk Court fire that it would be established before the end of the year. The remaining balance of about HK$113 million from the "Bid Smart" scheme will go to the new bureau, on top of HK$300 million earmarked by the government, bringing the total to about HK$413 million. Of that, HK$313 million will fund fee waivers, initially focused on buildings under "Operation Building Bright 2.0", covering about 80% of private residential and composite buildings aged 30 years or more; owners of the remaining 20% of higher-value buildings would pay in full. The bureau aims to complete company registration and appoint its board within next month, with the first case-management team starting work then to contact owners of about 1,800 outstanding maintenance cases under "Bid Smart" that have yet to appoint contractors.

summary.en: TVB's 59th anniversary gala, "TVB Anniversary Gala", was held at Television City on the evening of November 19, with more than 200 artistes taking part. Headline performer Andy Hui, appearing in the same event as Kenneth Ma for the first time since the 2019 "On Sum" incident seven years ago, said neither of them felt awkward; Ma was not seen on stage while Hui performed, avoiding a shared frame, and only reappeared for the grand prize draw at the end. Roger Kwok led more than 170 artistes in the opening song-and-dance numbers "Kei Gor" and "Old Time Buddy", revealing numbness in the sole of his right foot and saying he will seek further checks and acupuncture. In the "Tung Cheung Goddess Cup" 400-metre race, Samantha Lee won in 1 minute 25 seconds, followed by Hilary Lei and Ting Yan Chan. The gala's grand prize of a HK$450,000 credit-card spending waiver was won by "Midlife, Sing & Shine" contestant Ngan Chi-hang; Wong Kim-man had drawn a HK$100,000 prize but missed it after going to a convenience store for a chicken thigh, with the prize going to Pierre Ngo. Executive chairman Thomas Hui previewed a show at Kai Tak's main venue next year and five new drama productions.
summary.zh_hans: 无线庆祝 59 周年《万千星辉贺台庆》19 日晚在电视城举行，逾 200 名艺人参与。压轴嘉宾许志安在「安心事件」7 年后与马国明首度同场，两人都表示不尴尬；许志安演出时马国明未有现身台前，避过同框，直至尾声大抽奖才再现身。罗嘉良带领逾 170 名艺人打头阵跳唱《奇哥》及《难兄难弟》，自爆右脚脚底麻痹，将再检查及针灸。《东张女神杯》400 米赛跑，李旻芳以 1 分 25 秒夺冠，黎宽怡第二、陈庭欣第三。台庆大奖 45 万元信用卡免找数签账额由《中年好声音》颜志恒夺得；黄剑文原本抽中 10 万元奖品但到便利店食鸡髀错失机会，由曹永廉补上。行政主席许涛预告明年去启德主场馆举行一个骚，并将开拍 5 部剧。
summary.zh_hant: 無綫慶祝 59 周年《萬千星輝賀台慶》19 日晚在電視城舉行，逾 200 名藝人參與。壓軸嘉賓許志安在「安心事件」7 年後與馬國明首度同場，兩人都表示不尷尬；許志安演出時馬國明未有現身台前，避過同框，直至尾聲大抽獎才再現身。羅嘉良帶領逾 170 名藝人打頭陣跳唱《奇哥》及《難兄難弟》，自爆右腳腳底麻痺，將再檢查及針灸。《東張女神盃》400 米賽跑，李旻芳以 1 分 25 秒奪冠，黎寬怡第二、陳庭欣第三。台慶大獎 45 萬元信用卡免找數簽帳額由《中年好聲音》顏志恒奪得；黃劍文原本抽中 10 萬元獎品但到便利店食雞髀錯失機會，由曹永廉補上。行政主席許濤預告明年去啟德主場館舉行一個騷，並將開拍 5 部劇。
